name: Azerbaijan Soviet Socialist Republic (1927–1931)
description: A red field with a yellow hammer and sickle and star in the upper hoist beside the republic's initials in yellow, 'A.S.З.C.' in mixed Latin and Cyrillic letters above Arabic script.
history: Version of the Azerbaijan SSR flag used from 1927, when the initials were rendered in the new Latin-based Azerbaijani alphabet alongside Arabic script. The Arabic line was dropped in 1931.

features.role: initials in Latin-Cyrillic and Arabic script
